It’s in a small cut out with clearly marked arrows pointing to which way the entrance is, in addition to the fact that since this is a drive up ATM it makes sense for the machine to be on the left side where the driver would be sitting. That said, it’s very easy for people to turn I to the outcropping the wrong way. This happened today while I went to get some cash. However I stick to the notion that I was in the right for not moving because they were going against traffic. AITA?
